Cash only, no margin, no options buying; covered calls OK

sections.heading: Trusts & POA
items: Revocable living trust: grantor controls, assets still in estate; grantor often = trustee = beneficiary
Irrevocable trust: grantor CANNOT be trustee or beneficiary if removing from estate
FPOA = deposit/withdraw/trade; LPOA = trade only, no withdrawals
ALL POAs (incl. durable) END at death of either party
Durable POA survives grantor's INCAPACITY only, not death
TOD: available on individual & JTWROS; avoids probate, NOT estate tax

Yes (phases out if covered by plan)

sections.heading: IRA Rules — Key Numbers
items: Rollover: 60-day window, ONE per rolling 12 months (across all IRAs)
Transfer (custodian-to-custodian): UNLIMITED
RMD age = 73 (rising to 75 in 2033); first RMD may be delayed to 4/1 of following year
Failure to take RMD penalty = 25% (10% if timely corrected) — was 50%
Excess contribution penalty = 6%/year until withdrawn
10% early-withdrawal exceptions: death, disability, 1st home ($10k), education, medical, unemployment health premiums
PROHIBITED in IRA: collectibles, life insurance, short sales, margin, naked options, munis (no benefit)

rows: Employer bears investment risk; formula-based payout
High limits; donor controls; no income cap
For disabled before age 26; tax-free growth for qualified disability expenses

sections.heading: Cash vs Margin (Reg T)
items: Reg T initial margin = 50% of purchase
FINRA minimum equity = $2,000 OR 100% of purchase if less
Maintenance: 25% long / 30% short (FINRA); houses can require more
Payment deadline: Reg T = S+2 (i.e., T+4 since T+2 settlement)
Required forms: Credit Agreement + Hypothecation Agreement (MANDATORY); Loan Consent (OPTIONAL)
Risk disclosure required at opening AND annually
MARGINABLE: listed stocks/bonds, Nasdaq, warrants. Mutual funds & new issues = marginable after 30 days held
NOT marginable: options, rights, insurance products

sections.heading: Accounts That CANNOT Use Margin
items: All IRAs and qualified retirement plans
UGMA/UTMA custodial accounts
Coverdell ESAs
Trusts/corporations/partnerships UNLESS document specifically permits

sections.heading: Discretion — The 3 A's
items: Discretion exists if RR chooses ANY of: Action (buy/sell), Amount (shares/$), Asset (which security)
TIME and PRICE only = NOT discretion (no written auth needed, but good for that day only)
Requires: written customer authorization BEFORE first discretionary trade + principal approval
Each discretionary order must be marked 'discretionary' and reviewed promptly by principal
Discretion is granted to the RR personally — ends if RR leaves firm

sections.heading: KYC / Suitability (Reg BI for retail)
items: Required at account opening: name, DOB, address, SSN/TIN, employment, citizenship, ID verification (CIP/Patriot Act)
Investment profile: objectives, time horizon, risk tolerance, liquidity needs, tax status, net worth, income, experience
Update profile at least every 36 months
Forms signed by customer: Margin (credit + hypothec), Options agreement (within 15 days of approval), W-9
New account form signed by PRINCIPAL (not required of customer); customer signature optional but best practice

sections.heading: Fee-Based / Wrap Accounts
items: Flat fee or % of AUM covers advice + execution + admin
Suitable for ACTIVE traders; UNSUITABLE for buy-and-hold (reverse churning)
Generally investment advisory — fiduciary standard, Form ADV delivery required

common_traps: RMD age is now 73 (NOT 70½ or 72) and penalty is 25% (NOT 50%) — exam may still test old numbers; know both
Roth IRA has NO RMDs during owner's lifetime; Traditional does
TOD avoids PROBATE but NOT estate tax — students confuse these
Loan Consent Agreement is OPTIONAL; only Credit + Hypothecation are mandatory for margin
Time & Price discretion is NOT discretion — no written authorization needed (valid for that day only)
UGMA/UTMA: tax ID is the MINOR's SSN, taxed at minor's rate; cash account only — no margin, no buying options (covered calls OK)
